falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,200 on any single day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 low invalidates the bottom pattern match; the 78% similarity to bottom_2024_aug required holding that structural support, and its loss confirms this was not a bottom formation but a continuation pattern

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for two consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 41 already indicates elevated but controlled stress; sustained VIX above 35 confirms genuine panic rather than the contained capitulation typical of a bottom, meaning the current HOLD signal missed an acceleration into crisis rather than stabilization

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops more than 40 basis points from current level within any 3-day window
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A rapid flight-to-quality of that magnitude indicates systemic credit stress or recession panic, which would invalidate a bottom call because true bottoms form on growth scare resolution, not intensification; the macro engine's pattern match assumed economic stabilization
